temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith she is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes for seeming short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him because of an unknown mistake or misunderstanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth's curtness is explained by personal stress, not anger toward Keith.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal matters.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and supportive, and possibly offer help if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers Elizabeth someone to talk to or a coffee break; Elizabeth accepts and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with Keith.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: Elizabeth welcomes Keith's support and is willing to spend time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his support and is receptive to talking over coffee.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen and offer supportive company during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her severe stress; Keith suggests professional help; Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under significant personal stress and values Keith's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/deepened: Her stress seems severe enough that professional help could benefit her, but she is unsure about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth may benefit from professional help but is hesitant and uncertain.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and cautious about not offending her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently encourage professional help while respecting her hesitation and continuing to support her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion; Keith apologizes for possibly overstepping; Elizabeth says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his professional-help suggestion may have embarrassed or upset Elizabeth.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth says he did not overstep; her withdrawal likely reflects processing rather than offense.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend Elizabeth; she appreciates his concern but still has a lot to consider.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support and avoid pushing or overstepping.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth appears more open and appreciative; she thanks Keith and says his support means a lot and makes her feel better.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates Keith's concern but is still processing a lot and may need space.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/strengthened: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing she has it; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks.
